ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The image is a food web diagram, with multiple green ovals marking different organisms, and blue arrows indicating energy flowing from food sources to consumers. In the lower right of the image, there is a green oval labeled "Dogwood", and the related arrows starting from Dogwood point to the oval labeled "Deer". The question asks if dogwood trees were burned down by fire, which organism would need to find a new energy source. According to the direction of the arrows in the food web, Dogwood is one of the energy sources of Deer, so after losing Dogwood, the one that needs to find a new energy source is Deer.
